explanation.headline: FDA's records show idarubicin hydrochloride is not on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include idarubicin hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 45 vials of the 1 mg/mL, 20 mL presentation with a daily use of 3.6 vials, providing 12.6 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Hikma's label names no plant that could be placed for supply verification.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
